questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with San Marino?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture San Marino on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the San Marino article.

questions.proof: It is in Southern Europe and is fully surrounded by Italy (this is called an enclave, and only the Vatican City, Lesotho and San Marino are like this).

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of San Marino?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the San Marino article.

questions.proof: People in San Marino speak the Italian language.

questions.prompt: What money is used in San Marino?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the San Marino article.

questions.proof: San Marino (officially called the Most Serene Republic of San Marino) is a country in Europe.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The very small nation was recognized by Napoleon's France in _____, and by the other European nations at the 1815 Congress of Vienna.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the eighteenth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the San Marino article.

questions.proof: The very small nation was recognized by Napoleon's France in 1797, and by the other European nations at the 1815 Congress of Vienna.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “San Marino is the third smallest country in Europe, Only Vatican City and _____ are smaller.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “City”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the San Marino article, under the heading “Geography”.

questions.proof: San Marino is the third smallest country in Europe, Only Vatican City and Monaco are smaller.
